SMT. B. VINEETHA, GOVERNMENT PLEADER  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 06.01.2020, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C).No.34790 OF 2019  3  JUDGMENT
This writ petition is filed challenging Ext.P6 instruction issued by the Village Officer.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Government Pleader.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners are using the water from the quarry in question only for industrial purposes and Ext.P6 is a complete ban imposed for usage of water from the quarry for any purposes.

It is submitted that since Ext.P5 order was issued by the 4th respondent in the background of report to the effect that the contaminated water from abandoned quarries are being used without treatment for drinking purposes and that the complete ban imposed by Ext.P6 is not sustainable.
4. I am of the opinion that it is for the petitioners to bring the factual aspects of the matter including the use that they are putting the water to, to the notice of the 4 th respondent.

In case the petitioners submit a proper representation pointing out that they are not using the water for any drinking water C.P.Shaji vs State Of Kerala on 6 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58596017/
